label: SIMULATION: ASSUMED reduced planar WBR, newly synthesized LQR

wheel_radius.note: Observer constant, not a physical measurement.

wheel_mass.source: Phase1 teaching-model choice; combined wheel pair.

wheel_inertia.source: Combined rolling-axis inertia; retained as slider armature I/r^2.

leg_length.source: Fixed axle-to-hip length selected within upstream commanded range; not fivebar geometry.

leg_mass.source: Combined equivalent rigid legs, not measured links.

leg_com.source: COM above axle along equivalent leg.

leg_inertia.source: COM pitch inertia of combined equivalent legs.

body_mass.source: Body assembly mass unknown; illustrative choice.

body_com.source: Body COM above hip along body axis.

body_inertia.source: Body COM pitch inertia unknown; illustrative choice.

wheel_torque_limit.source: Aggregate wheel-pair input cap; not upstream per-wheel clamp or measured capability.

hip_torque_limit.source: Aggregate virtual hip torque cap; no fivebar VMC or joint mapping.

source_geometry_inventory_unused.note: Reference inventory only. Full fivebar VMC is deferred; these dimensions do not define the reduced rigid leg.

simulation.source: New synchronous 500 Hz simulation/control choice, not measured hardware timing.

controller.source: New design weights on dimensional SI states/inputs; not recovered upstream gains.
controller.cost: sum dt*(state.T Q state + torque.T R torque); no exact continuous cost integration claim

protocol.initial_note: Independent absolute leg +8 deg, body -6 deg; same initial state in balance, push, open_loop.
protocol.push_location: Body COM, world +x, xfrc_applied, no applied moment.
protocol.criteria: BALANCE/PUSH: no fall, displacement <=1.5m, no numerical warning/reset, actuator caps respected, all six errors within tolerances continuously through final 1s, recovery within 5s of initial tilt or pulse end. PUSH must apply full declared impulse. OPEN_LOOP: exactly zero actuator controls, tilt grows >=5x and reaches 45deg by 5s on identical model.
protocol.source: New bounded simulation experiment, declared before first run; not a hardware acceptance criterion.
